headlines.headline: WCF GAME 1 TONIGHT: WEMBANYAMA'S SPURS VS. SGA'S THUNDER, 8:30 PM ET
headlines.detail: Victor Wembanyama's San Antonio Spurs and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's Oklahoma City Thunder tip off Game 1 of the Western Conference Finals tonight at 8:30 PM ET on NBC.

headlines.headline: RODGERS RE-SIGNS STEELERS ON 1-YEAR DEAL UP TO $25M; OTAS BEGIN
headlines.detail: Aaron Rodgers officially re-signed with Pittsburgh for a 22nd NFL season on a 1-year contract worth up to $25 million and took first-team reps on the opening day of OTAs.

headlines.headline: HUSKIES MOVE IOWA, PURDUE GAMES TO FRIDAY NIGHTS; PORTAL ERA SETTLING IN
headlines.detail: UW's games against Iowa and at Purdue have been moved to Friday night slots. Programs are finalizing depth charts nationally as the portal cycle closes.

headlines.headline: MICHIGAN ATOP EARLY 76-TEAM BRACKET; NBA WITHDRAW DEADLINE MAY 27
headlines.detail: Reigning national champion Michigan leads Andy Katz's first projection for next season's expanded 76-team NCAA Tournament. May 27 is the NBA Draft withdraw deadline.
